##### Project general facts

Rixos Dubai Islands Hotel & Residences is a premium beachfront development set within the vibrant destination of Dubai Islands, offering a refined island lifestyle with a resort-inspired atmosphere. The project features a selection of residences designed for comfort and elegance, surrounded by pristine beaches and lush landscapes. With its contemporary architecture and thoughtfully designed spaces, it creates a perfect balance between tranquil coastal living and proximity to the city.

The development offers a wide range of lifestyle amenities tailored for all ages, creating a dynamic and family-friendly environment. Residents can enjoy access to luxury resort facilities, wellness and sports venues, green open spaces, and beachfront leisure areas. The community is designed to encourage relaxation, recreation, and social connection, complemented by village centres with retail, dining, and entertainment options.

The residences feature elegant interiors with a timeless design, combining warm wood tones, stone finishes, lacquer elements, and brushed champagne metal accents. Large glass panels maximise natural light and provide seamless indoor-outdoor flow, enhancing the sense of space and connection to the surroundings. Kitchens are equipped with engineered stone countertops, wood veneer cabinetry, and modern appliances, while bathrooms feature refined stone and porcelain finishes. The residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a major waterfront destination located along Dubai’s northern coastline, designed as a collection of four interconnected islands that combine residential, hospitality, leisure, and entertainment experiences. The area is being developed around a relaxed coastal lifestyle, with expansive waterfront spaces, sandy beaches, landscaped promenades, and views across the Arabian Gulf.

The destination offers a diverse mix of residential communities, luxury hotels, retail, dining, and recreational facilities, creating a vibrant environment for both residents and visitors. Its waterfront setting provides opportunities for beach activities, water sports, cycling, and leisurely walks, while landscaped public spaces and promenades create a peaceful connection with nature.

Dubai Islands also benefits from convenient connectivity to the rest of the city through major road networks, with Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and other key destinations within easy reach. With its combination of beachfront living, modern infrastructure, and growing selection of lifestyle amenities, Dubai Islands is emerging as one of Dubai’s distinctive new coastal destinations.
